message.content:
The address **www.home.fedex.com/express** does not appear to be a standard FedEx page from the results provided. The closest relevant FedEx pages are the main FedEx home page, the login pages, and FedEx Home Delivery information[4][7][5][2].

If you meant **FedEx Home Delivery**, that service delivers to residential addresses in all 50 states, typically in 1–5 days in the contiguous U.S., and supports Saturday and Sunday delivery[2].

If you meant a **login or account page**, FedEx’s secure login pages are separate from the main home delivery information pages[3][5].
